body.name: resTok
body.def: A token \(r=(R,K,\mathcal J,\mathcal P,\mathcal C)\) stores the irreducible active mask, its labelled kernels and constraints, the finite list \(\mathcal P\) of rational projection circuits generated by the fixed labelled elimination order, and the finite list \(\mathcal C\) of tensor products of signed canonical response-row swaps, all in encoded order.
